raw_graphql_pull_request.body: The repo now provides a root-level entrypoint (./primus-cli). Some docs still referenced ./runner/primus-cli or primus-cli, which is inconsistent and less copy‑paste friendly when users run from the repository root.

nodes.body:
## Pull request overview

This PR updates documentation and examples to use the new root-level `./primus-cli` entrypoint instead of the previous `./runner/primus-cli` or bare `primus-cli` references, improving consistency and usability when running commands from the repository root.

**Changes:**
- Added a new root-level `primus-cli` wrapper script that delegates to `runner/primus-cli`
- Updated all documentation examples to use `./primus-cli` from the repo root
- Added a new section in CLI documentation explaining how to run from a source checkout

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| primus-cli | New root-level wrapper script that executes `runner/primus-cli` |
| docs/quickstart.md | Updated command examples to use `./primus-cli` |
| docs/cli/README.md | Added section on running from source checkout |
| docs/cli/PRIMUS-CLI-GUIDE.md | Updated all command examples and documentation to use `./primus-cli` |
| README.md | Updated training example to use `./primus-cli` |
</details>

This line shows the command being executed inside the container, but the container won't have `./primus-cli` at its root. This should reference `runner/primus-cli-direct.sh` or the actual internal invocation path used within the container, not the repository-root wrapper.
```suggestion
                  runner/primus-cli-direct.sh --config prod.yaml --debug direct \
```
